resonances.name: J/ψ
resonances.what: cc̄ 1S — the November 1974 revolution (BNL and SLAC)
resonances.note: μμ branching ratio 6 % — the tallest narrow peak in the spectrum

resonances.name: Υ(1S)
resonances.what: bb̄ 1S — Fermilab 1977, the discovery of the b quark

resonances.name: Υ(2S)
resonances.note: resolved from the 1S and 3S by the CMS muon resolution

resonances.name: Z
resonances.what: the neutral weak boson — CERN 1983 (UA1, UA2)
resonances.note: μμ branching ratio 3.4 %; the width here is the natural width, not resolution
